question: Do the s049 cascade survivors cluster around truth (so cluster-reps can be LM-polished), or are they a uniform thinning of (q_a, omega) space?
hypothesis: Cascade survivors concentrate on truth, reducing to a few hundred clusters -- the Phase 2 LM-budget precondition.
narrative_md: Decisive negative for the s049 seed-generator framing: the 35835 cascade survivors are nearly a uniform thinning of (q_a, omega) space -- q-dist-to-truth median 129 deg (random SO(3) median 123 deg), and truth-q_a enrichment is 0.59x (filter is mildly anti-truth). At 5deg/5% they form 32640 canonical clusters, 163x over the 200-cluster LM gate. 'Truth survives' != 'truth is selected'. Phase 3 (omega-noise reduction) becomes first priority. Reads actual truth state for all distance metrics.
